a11y.accessibleName: Visible text content. An icon-only button requires aria-label.
notes: Uses the native button element so browser keyboard behavior and form participation stay predictable.
type defaults to button, not submit, so a button inside a form does not submit it by accident.
Disabled buttons are removed from the tab order by the platform. Where the reason for disabling is not obvious, prefer an enabled button that explains the problem on activation.

whenToUse: Performing an action: saving, submitting, deleting, opening a dialog.
whenNotToUse: Navigating to another page. Use Link, so that middle-click, right-click and browser history all behave as the user expects.
